headline: Ipo and Bustos Dams Release Water After Breaching Spilling Levels in Bulacan
seoTitle: Ipo, Bustos Dams Release Water in Bulacan | FMB News
seoDescription: Ipo and Bustos dams released excess water after prolonged Habagat rains pushed reservoir levels beyond spilling marks, prompting downstream flood warnings in Bulacan.
deck: Authorities warned downstream communities to remain alert as water releases added to already swollen river systems after days of monsoon rain.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Continuous rains from the Southwest Monsoon pushed Ipo and Bustos dams in Bulacan beyond their spilling levels, prompting operators to release excess water into downstream river systems.

The Philippine Star reported that Ipo Dam stood at 101.63 meters as of 1 p.m. Saturday, 63 centimeters above its spilling level, and was releasing 323 cubic meters per second toward Bustos Dam. Bustos operators were also continuing downstream releases as of Saturday afternoon.

sections.heading: Downstream risk
paragraphs: Water released from the two dams flows through river systems serving communities including Bustos, San Rafael, Baliwag, Pulilan, Plaridel, Calumpit and Hagonoy before draining toward Manila Bay. Residents in low-lying areas were advised to stay alert for possible river overflow and flooding.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The releases come after prolonged Habagat rains saturated Central Luzon. Dam releases can compound river and drainage pressures already elevated by runoff and local rainfall, although downstream impacts depend on discharge rates, tides, tributary flows and continuing rainfall.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Communities downstream of controlled releases need timely information because river levels can change quickly. Official dam, PAGASA and local disaster advisories should take precedence over social-media estimates or old discharge figures.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for updated Ipo and Bustos reservoir elevations, gate operations, downstream river levels and evacuation advisories from PAGASA, dam operators and Bulacan disaster authorities.
